column6: First complete clean semantic decoder: real IconEntry fields, all RLE command classes, clipping, dim palette, mapped literal copy, newline, and file-static scratch addresses reconstructed from retail.
Reordered entry/X/source setup locals; broadened the setup divergence and reduced the focused score.
Removed the local entry lifetime and used only the published entry global; did not recover retail setup allocation.
Narrowed the command local to unsigned char; changed compare/register shape broadly.
Used the published start-X/Y values in the setup clip predicates; retained into later states.
Expanded the left-clipped fill arm into separate both-clipped and left-only memset calls. This recovered retail's five distinct inlined memset bodies and was retained.
Matched shadow command publication order: dim length first; flags before the override test; count/value only on the override fill edge; count/flags at dim entry.
Kept dim destination local in both loops, removed per-iteration destination-global stores, and republished the dim palette per iteration as retail does at +0x392/+0x455.

Removed destination-global publication from the literal inner loop while retaining the source cursor publication. Retail keeps destination in EBX and advances the global copy source at +0x549..+0x567.

Modeled X, row, source, and destination as direct globals throughout. This over-published state (44 excess relocations) and proved retail instead uses register-held locals with selective file-static publications.
